definition: the time set for doing your work
description: A warehouse loading bay at dawn. A German shepherd dog in a yellow hard hat and orange safety vest stands on its hind legs, pushes a time card into a clock machine on the wall, then drops down and walks off with a card in its mouth. A line of other dogs in yellow hard hats waits behind, and a border collie with a card in its mouth steps up next. A round wall clock and a board of shift times hang on the wall, and a woman in a safety vest, a forklift and pallets are behind.

en.question: What is the black-and-white dog carrying?

de.answer: Er trägt eine Karte im Maul.
de.question: Was trägt der schwarz-weiße Hund?

es.answer: Está llevando una tarjeta en la boca.
